economy.title: Pricing, Refills & Enforcement
economy.intro: Adjust live AI feature pricing, configure student promotional refills, and set credit gating rules without deployments.
economy.enforcementIntro: Controls whether the system strictly bills students, runs in trial monitoring, or allows unrestricted free access.
economy.shadowTitle: Shadow Active — AI actions execute without blocking students
economy.shadowDescription: Students will not encounter payment prompts or 402 barriers even if their wallet balance is zero. Quoted credit costs are silently recorded for analytics. Remember to switch back to Enforce (Production) when you are ready to collect revenue.
economy.offTitle: Credit Engine Disabled — Full Platform Subsidy
economy.offDescription: All balance checks, quotas, and credit deductions are completely bypassed. Students have unrestricted free access to all AI features at your organization's direct expense.
economy.highRisk: ⚠️ High risk: Your organization absorbs 100% of LLM provider API token costs.
economy.walletIntro: Define the initial credits granted to new students and the daily midnight replenishment amount.
economy.welcomeHelp: Initial budget for students to try AI generation immediately upon signup.
economy.refillHelp: Maximum promotional credits refilled each day.
economy.timezoneResetHelp: At 00:00:00 in this timezone, all daily free quotas and promotional refills reset.
economy.settingsReasonPlaceholder: e.g. Switched to production enforcement and updated welcome allowance
economy.pricingIntro: Set the credit cost and daily free uses for each AI action. Setting cost to 0 keeps the action free.
economy.policyReasonPlaceholder: Required audit reason (e.g. Adjusted defense simulation and report builder pricing)
economy.auditIntro: Permanent cryptographic audit log of all economic changes, reasons, and version increments.
economy.errorLoad: Could not load the credit economy.
economy.reasonPricing: Please provide a short change reason for the audit log before saving pricing.
economy.reasonSinglePolicy: Please enter a change reason below before saving “{{label}}”.
economy.reasonSettings: Please enter a change reason for the audit log before updating wallet defaults.
economy.settingsUpdated: Wallet defaults and enforcement rules updated.
economy.dailyRefillHelp: If student promotional balance is below this amount, it refills up to this target.

enforce.title: Enforce (Production)
enforce.subtitle: Strict Real-Time Balance Gating
enforce.description: Blocks students with HTTP 402 if their credit wallet is depleted. Checks daily free quota first, then deducts from promotional and purchased balance.
enforce.financialImpact: Protects your LLM API bill from runaway costs and drives credit top-up sales.

shadow.title: Shadow (Evaluation)
shadow.subtitle: Silent Telemetry (No Blocking)
shadow.description: Students are never blocked, even with 0 credits. Quoted credit costs are silently recorded in the database to observe student demand.
shadow.financialImpact: Zero user friction, but the platform absorbs 100% of LLM costs without receiving payments.

off.title: Off (Dangerous)
off.subtitle: Complete Credit Bypass
off.description: Credit deduction and gating are turned off. All AI actions execute completely free with zero balance verification.
off.financialImpact: CRITICAL: Uncapped API billing. Only use for closed offline demos; never in production.

requests.title: Credit Requests
requests.intro: Review manual credit purchase requests, confirm external payment, and fulfill wallets through the existing ledger.
requests.filterStudent: Filter by student, email, or phone...
requests.emptyDescription: New student requests will appear here.
requests.completedMessage: This request has been completed and credited.
requests.cancelDescription: No credits will be added and the student request will be marked as cancelled.
requests.confirmDescription: This marks the payment request as confirmed. Credits will still wait until you add them to the wallet.
requests.addCreditsDescription: This will add exactly {{credits}} purchased credits to {{student}}'s wallet.
requests.optionalReason: Optional reason shown in admin history...
requests.creditsEmailSent: Credits added and confirmation email sent.
requests.creditsSmtpMissing: Credits added. SMTP must be configured to send the confirmation email.
requests.errorAddCredits: Could not add credits to the wallet.
